WHAT WE'RE SOLVING

Invisible problems.
Very real consequences.

DrainGuard makes everyday drainage issues easier to see, locate and manage. Residents report what they find; the team is developing backend and risk-model integration for coordinated preventive action.

Blocked drainage

A single blocked outlet can leave an entire street vulnerable when intense rainfall arrives.

Connect your team's backend

For Person 3 / SARJANA M K S. No API keys or passwords are needed here.

Current SARJANA backend API

POST /api/complaints requires application/json:
{"title":"Blocked drain",
 "description":"Issue details and address",
 "latitude":13.05,"longitude":80.25,
 "risk_level":"high"}
Response: {"complaint":{"complaint_id":"DG-...","status":"submitted"}}
GET /api/complaints/{id} responds with {"complaint":{...}}. Only title, description, coordinates and risk level are stored by this backend; extra form fields are included in the description, and photos are not uploaded yet. Different origins require the backend to enable CORS or serve this page itself.
